shared_elements: carved figural motifs in low relief on a flat stone surface
elongated linear appendages (limbs/tails) rendered as raised ridges
justification: Both show simplified figures carved in low relief as raised ridged silhouettes, and each includes creature-like forms with extended limbs, but that is about as generic as figural carving gets. A depicts a single isolated quadruped in strict profile, head low and body horizontal, dominating an otherwise blank panel, whereas B is a crowded field of frontal, schematic anthropomorph-like figures with raised arms plus intersecting straight lines and smaller shapes, with no shared posture, combination or layout.
